title: anemone trifolia subsp. lancifolia
intro: Anemone trifolia subsp. lancifolia, commonly known as Wood Anemone, is a perennial plant species belonging to the buttercup family (Ranunculaceae). It is native to Europe, Western Asia, and North Africa. The plant has been traditionally used in herbal medicine to treat various ailments, with its health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral properties. The therapeutic actions of Anemone trifolia subsp. lancifolia include pain relief, wound healing, and immune system support, attributed to its bioactive constituents such as alkaloids, glycosides, and phenolic compounds.
